title: Privacy Stack 3/4 - strong ad and tracker filtering
description: Apply a backed-up Balanced-Strong Pi-hole filtering baseline using HaGeZi Pro for ads/trackers and HaGeZi TIF for malicious infrastructure, rebuild gravity, verify effective blocking and preserve rollback copies.
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$r=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/status' -TimeoutSec 12;if(-not $r.pihole.blocking){throw 'filtering disabled'};if([int64]$r.pihole.gravity-lt10000){throw 'gravity too small'};$l=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/adlists' -TimeoutSec 12;$a=@($l.items.address);if($a -notcontains 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists/main/domains/pro.txt'){throw 'Pro list missing'};if($a -notcontains 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists/main/domains/tif.txt'){throw 'TIF list missing'};Write-Host ('PRIVACY_FILTER_TEST=PASS;GRAVITY='+$r.pihole.gravity)
rollback: Write-Host 'Filter backend preserves timestamped gravity.db backups under /var/backups/3en-security-privacy; automatic restore is executed if gravity rebuild fails.'
